title: 第13章 男人的坚持第14章 强势的一条龙
content_zh:
第十三章 男人的坚持
听到主裁判吹响了上半场结束的哨音，王利长长的呼了一口气。
在这短短的四十五分钟的比赛中，无数次的奔跑、阻截、抢断、带球突破，精神紧张加上不停的跑动，他几乎是全场最累的一个人，这使得自己的身体有些匮乏了。
即使内力的缓缓流动能够帮助他慢慢回复体能，也有些吃不消了。身上的衣着早已被汗水浸湿，嘴里也很是干涩，他迈着略显沉重的步伐，向着球员通道走去。
看到他的样子，一直呆坐在替补席上的室友托马斯.维阿马上跑了过来，递给他一罐水。他挥手接过后，张开嘴就向下面倒去。
“慢点喝，艾伦，你表现的太出色的，尤其是那个傻大个查德维克，我看他已经被你过的大脑不清醒了，真不知道今天比赛过后，会有多少伍尔弗汉普顿的少女给你写情书，以后你发达了可要照顾下和你同室而居的我，最好是介绍几个胸部比较大的少*妇，我最喜欢那种类型了……”
托马斯一脸淫笑的跟在王利后面慢慢走着，嘴里唠叨个不停，话语间透露的词汇实在让人感到浑身发冷。
王利无奈的摇摇头，不理会这个**的公猪，径直朝着更衣室走去。
不一会儿，各个队员都陆续回到了更衣室中，找到位置静默的坐着。上半场比赛太过激烈了，使得大家都消耗了不少体力，他们要在这短短的时间里恢复些体能才行。
不过托马斯显然是例外，他不断的讲着头脑中想到的曼联队队员XX在下半场将要发生的趣事，更衣室里不时便传出一阵哄笑声。
老伍德推开房门，缓缓走了进来，微笑的看着面前的这些年轻的球员，看来他对上半场比赛很是满意。
“上半场比赛，你们打的很不错，不过还是有一些问题。劳莱丝，你应该多带球，不要一味的传给中路，多在左边突破更具威胁，而且在下半场曼联一定会加强右路的防守，艾伦的压力也会增加，所以还要靠你
“好的，伍德先生。”劳莱丝缓缓点头答道。
“提姆，下半场你要减少上前的次数，曼联的进攻很快，这样容易造成后方漏洞，前面有哈利尔森和皮特就可以了，艾伦要增加长传的次数，有机会就掉向禁区，你们两个前锋站位要尽量靠前一些。”提姆和王利同时点了点头。
“还有就是，艾伦，你不要做开场时候那么危险的动作，虽然很花俏，但却不太实用，那个球能进纯粹是运气！”
“下半场阵型不变，继续这么打，早晚会追平的，开场时候要小心曼联队的偷袭…”
于此同时，曼联队的更衣室中，主教练保罗－麦克吉尼斯正在狠力批评查德维克。
“你的技术呢？怎么那么容易就被那个黑发小子过去，整个上半场你至少被他过了十次以上，即使不能抢断，你就不能跟着他吗？”
查德维克对此也只能无奈的低着头，一副接受教育的老实样子，他知道，保罗教练最讨厌别人和他顶嘴了。
“还有福琼，我看你也和这小子一样，每次都被甩开，算了，那个小子也确实有些本事，不过也不是没有缺点的…”说道这里，保罗脸上闪过一丝笑意。

“他基本不会和队友配合，我统计了他上半场短传次数，也只有四次而已，伍尔弗汉普顿排出了一个523阵型，他们就是想打艾伦.王这个点，所以只要掐住这个点，这场比赛就十拿九稳了，纳尔蒂耶罗，你和福琼还有理查森主要防守这个小子，对他全场紧逼，封锁住他的接球路线，这个小子是个新人，不会跑位，得不到队友支持技术在好也没用。”
“里佩奇，你下半场换下查德维克，去打右边锋。”
“下半场一定要稳住，伍尔弗汉普顿的实力并不强，只要能在进一个，接下来的时间就很轻松了。”
下半场开始之后，王利就遇到了大麻烦，有三个曼联球员一直在自己周围走动，这使得队友根本无法传球给他，他伸手要了几次球，都被直接在半路截断了。
跑位他并不擅长，这使得王利很被动，他在二十几分钟内仅仅触球两次，还有一次是直接跑到后场才拿到的。
这段时间的无作为使得上半场那个技术华丽的小子几乎消失在了球场上，解说员一次一次的呼喊：“我们的艾伦在哪里？？？”
没有了王利的长传支持，前场的皮特和哈利尔森也很无奈，他们一直在曼联的半场游走着，不过这显然有些徒劳。
除了劳莱丝偶尔能突破过来对曼联构成一点点威胁之外，足球几乎都在伍尔弗汉普顿的半场间传递，这使得托姆.史密斯成为了全场最忙碌的人。
幸好他今天状态不错，左挡右挡，一次次的倒地，守卫着伍尔弗汉普顿最后的防线。而下半场曼联队的球员显然没带射门靴，连续三次门柱看的旁边的王利都有些汗颜。
实际上，王利并不是不能摆脱黏在他身旁的几个曼联球员，要知道，他可是逍遥派的传人，凌波微步正是他的看家本领。
他是在等待机会。
由于上半场体力、内力都有些消耗过大，所以他一直缓缓的跑动，回复些体力，等待着爆发，他知道身体的内力也只能支持他一次爆发而已。
时间在缓缓的流动，观众席上的球迷们永不停息的给伍尔弗汉普顿的球员加油。即使比赛场上，他们支持的球队踢的很难看，好像在被曼联队戏耍一般，但这并不能阻挡他们的热情，他们的心，永远属于伍尔弗汉普顿。
观众席上响起了断断续续的歌声，很快就连成一片，他们在唱着助威的歌声，语调中夹带着对场中比赛的球员的殷切希望：
听着场中球迷们的支持声，伍尔弗汉普顿场上的队员们都有些精神振奋起来，曼联又怎么样，即使赢不了也要努力的坚持住，这是一种对球迷的报答，也是一种男人的坚持！
content_en:
Chapter Thirteen Men’s Persistence
Hearing the referee blow the whistle to end the first half, Wang Li took a long breath.
In this short forty-five-minute game, he had to run, block, steal, and break through with the ball countless times. The mental stress and constant running made him almost the most tired person in the game, which made his body somewhat exhausted.
Even if the slow flow of internal energy can help him slowly recover his physical strength, it is still too much. The clothes on his body were already soaked with sweat, and his mouth was very dry. He walked towards the player tunnel with slightly heavy steps.
Seeing his appearance, his roommate Thomas Weah, who had been sitting on the bench, immediately ran over and handed him a bottle of water. After he took it with a wave of his hand, he opened his mouth and fell down.
"Drink slowly, Alan, you performed too well, especially that stupid big Chadwick. I think he has been knocked unconscious by you. I really don't know how many girls from Wolverhampton will write you love letters after today's game. In the future, when you get rich, you have to take care of me who lives in the same room with you. It is best to introduce a few young women with larger breasts. I like that type best..."
Thomas walked slowly behind Wang Li with a lewd smile on his face, chattering incessantly, and the vocabulary revealed in his words really made people feel chilled all over.
Wang Li shook his head helplessly, ignored the **** boar, and walked straight to the locker room.
After a while, each team member returned to the locker room one after another, found a place to sit silently. The first half of the game was so intense that everyone consumed a lot of energy. They had to recover some physical fitness in this short period of time.
However, Thomas was obviously an exception. He kept talking about the interesting things that happened to Manchester United player XX in his mind in the second half, and bursts of laughter came from time to time in the locker room.
Old Wood opened the door and walked in slowly. He looked at the young players in front of him with a smile. It seemed that he was very satisfied with the first half of the game.
"In the first half of the game, you played very well, but there are still some problems. Lawless, you should dribble more, don't pass it blindly to the center, break more on the left to be more threatening, and in the second half, Manchester United will definitely strengthen the defense on the right, and Allen's pressure will also increase, so it depends on you.
"Okay, Mr. Wood. "Laurais nodded slowly and replied.
"Tim, in the second half, you need to reduce the number of times you go forward. Manchester United's attack is very fast, which can easily cause loopholes in the rear. Just have Harrelson and Peter in front. Allen needs to increase the number of long passes and fall into the penalty area when there is an opportunity. You two forwards should try to position themselves as far forward as possible. "Tim and Wang Li nodded at the same time.
"Also, Allen, don't do such dangerous moves at the beginning. Although they are very fancy, they are not very practical. It was pure luck that the goal was scored! "
"The formation remains unchanged in the second half. If we continue to play like this, we will tie it sooner or later. Be careful of Manchester United's sneak attack at the beginning..."
At the same time, in the Manchester United dressing room, coach Paul McGuinness was harshly criticizing Chadwick.
"What about your skills? How come you were passed by that black-haired kid so easily? You were passed by him at least ten times in the entire first half. Even if you couldn't steal, couldn't you follow him? "
Chadwick could only lower his head helplessly, as if he was receiving an education honestly. He knew that Coach Paul hated others talking back to him.
"And Fortune, I think you are just like this kid. You get thrown away every time. Forget it, that kid does have some abilities, but he is not without shortcomings..." After saying this, a smile flashed across Paul's face.
"He basically doesn't cooperate with his teammates. I counted the number of short passes he made in the first half, and there were only four. Wolverhampton arranged a 523 formation. They just wanted to beat Allen Wang.This is a point, so as long as you control this point, this game will be a sure thing. Nardiero, you, Fortune and Richardson mainly defend this kid, press him all over the court, and block his receiving route. This kid is a rookie and can't move. It's useless to have good skills without the support of his teammates. "
"Ripage, you replace Chadwick in the second half and play on the right wing. "
"We must be steady in the second half. Wolverhampton are not strong. As long as we can score one goal, the rest of the game will be easy. "
After the start of the second half, Wang Li ran into big trouble. Three Manchester United players kept walking around him, which made it impossible for his teammates to pass the ball to him. He reached out for the ball several times, but was intercepted halfway.
He is not good at running, which makes Wang Li very passive. He only touched the ball twice in 20 minutes, and once he got it by running directly into the backcourt.
The inaction during this period made the kid with gorgeous skills almost disappear from the court in the first half, and the commentator shouted again and again: "Where is our Allen? ? ? "
Without the support of Wang Li's long pass, Peter and Harrelson in the frontcourt were also helpless. They had been wandering in Manchester United's half, but this was obviously in vain.
Except for Lawless who occasionally broke through and posed a slight threat to Manchester United, the football was almost passed between Wolverhampton's half, which made Thom Smith the busiest person in the game.
Fortunately, he was in good condition today, blocking left and right, falling to the ground again and again, guarding Wolverhampton's last line of defense. In the second half, the Manchester United players obviously did not wear shooting boots. Wang Li next to him was a little embarrassed when he saw the goalpost three times in a row.
In fact, Wang Li is not unable to get rid of several Manchester United players who stick to him. You must know that he is a descendant of the Xiaoyao sect, and Lingbo Weibu is his special skill.
He is waiting for an opportunity.
Since his physical strength and internal strength were a bit too much in the first half, he kept running slowly to regain some strength and wait for the explosion. He knew that his body's internal strength could only support him for one explosion.
Time is flowing slowly, and the fans in the audience never stop cheering for the Wolverhampton players. Even if the team they support plays ugly on the field, as if they are being played by Manchester United, this does not stop their enthusiasm. Their hearts will always belong to Wolverhampton.
Intermittent singing rang out from the audience, and soon they became one. They were singing cheering songs, and their tone contained ardent hopes for the players on the field:
Listening to the support of the fans in the field, the Wolverhampton players were all in high spirits. So what about Manchester United? Even if they can't win, they have to work hard and persevere. This is a kind of repayment to the fans, and it is also a kind of man's persistence!
